humanEditorialPlacement.when: rowId is explicitly approved for SOF_INDIA_CLASS2 by a human_editor handoff after the historical public-official source audit

editorialPlacementReview.meaning: This disposition records an explicit Kidsplay human-editorial profile placement. It does not claim that SOF officially lists the word, that an exact public official row anchor exists, or that the 2026-08-31 SOF source audit covered this later-added membership.

sourceAudit.scopeNote: Terminal review of the accessible official SOF Class 2 public evidence corpus registered and recovered through 2026-08-31. This audit distinguishes current 2026-27 scope/sample material from historical samples and does not treat scope headings as exact row evidence. Its audited membership universe remains the 182-row snapshot that existed at that review date; later explicit editorial placements are terminalized separately and are not retroactively folded into this audit.
sourceAudit.deduplicationRule: Repeated public sample-paper facts count as one exact row anchor unless a distinct reproducible official locator supports a different canonical row.
sourceAudit.terminalMeaning: reviewed_no_exact_public_anchor means no reproducible exact public official row/skill anchor was found for that canonical row in the audited accessible corpus. It does not claim the fact never appeared in SOF, and it must not be rendered as official row provenance.
